question: Who won Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021 in football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunil Chhetri **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​****Sunil Chhetri**, captain of the Indian football team, is **one of the most active goal scorers in the country**. 
 
• He is the leading goal scorer in international football for India as well as in domestic football tournaments.
 
• **Sunil Chhetri **appeared in **54 international matches for India so far and has scored 41 goals which is almost half of his total goals tally (84)**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Gurpreet Singh Sandhu** is an **Indian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Indian Super League club Bengaluru and the India national team**
 
• **Subrata Paul** is an **Indian professional footballer **who plays as a **goalkeeper for Indian Super League club ATK Mohun Bagan, on loan from Hyderabad.**
 
• **Baichung Bhutia** is an **Indian former professional footballer who played as a striker**. 
 
 
• **Bhutia** is considered the **torchbearer of Indian football in the international arena.**
 
• He is often nicknamed the **Sikkimese Sniper because of his shooting skills in football.**
